2023-09-16
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at low speed and says the other vehicle struck the back of the insured car.
The claimant is not represented by a lawyer, and the driver is confirmed as the person named on the policy.
2023-09-21
The police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. The
other driver also describes the accident the same way, and the scene photos match the account.
2024-01-21
The repair estimate shows damage that is mostly in line with the described impact, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known. The impact was very light, yet the claimant reports a severe neck injury, which does not fit the
crash.
2024-01-22
The claimant later added a few small details about seating position and the moment of braking, but the core account
has stayed the same. A neighbor has told us the car appeared to be damaged some weeks before the claimed event,
and this needs follow-up.
2024-02-23
No earlier injury to the neck or upper back is known from the mediacl records received so far. Treatment followed a
usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
2024-04-06
File reviewed. The claim stays open pending follow-up on the neighbor's statement and a final medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
